cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. As building manager, I'll establish why this door won't lock. Describe the anomaly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hinge is loose. I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Precisely. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?

mechanism: A uses managerial authority to demand demonstrations and tool locations while pretending each borrowed step confirms expertise.
confusable: Unlike ordinary delegation, A needs B to supply both method and location while calling them investigative stages.
comparison: A door repair and A's own desk differ from a missing-tin inquiry.
seedUse: The seed explicitly names building manager and requires demonstration for assessment, already joining rank and borrowed procedure.
